title: Spot Premium on a Renew Business Asset Buyback Collection Asked For at Short Notice
content:
The spot premium follows the notice the collection is asked with, counted in calendar days from the day the charge is raised to the day the collection is asked for, and how often the carrier has been asked to come. How often the carrier has been asked to come is the number of shipment requests taken on the Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement.

**Where the collection is asked for within the programme's pickup lead days, and more than one shipment request has been taken on the agreement**
the spot premium is the repeat spot premium, being 85.00 USD.

**Where the collection is asked for within the programme's pickup lead days, and no more than one shipment request has been taken on the agreement**
the spot premium is the opening spot premium, being 45.00 USD.

**Where the collection is asked for at or beyond the programme's pickup lead days**
no spot premium is added.

**The notice counted.** The days of notice are calendar days from the day the charge is raised to the day the collection is asked for, taken from the collection day named on the latest shipment request for a freight collection standing on the agreement. The figure they are measured against is the days of notice a bulk collection needs on the Renew programme the agreement is written under.

**Both sides of each boundary.** A notice standing at exactly the programme's pickup lead days is at that figure and not within it, so no spot premium is added. A notice of one day fewer is within it, and the premium is then 85.00 USD where more than one shipment request stands on the agreement and 45.00 USD where one or none does. Two shipment requests are more than one; a single request is not.

| Days of notice | Shipment requests taken on the agreement | Spot premium |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fewer than the programme's pickup lead days | 2 or more | 85.00 USD |
| fewer than the programme's pickup lead days | 1 or none | 45.00 USD |
| the programme's pickup lead days or more | any number | nothing |
